items.title: Sober Holidays!
items.summary: December is a great time of year to reach out to alcoholics and help others. What are the ways you stay sane and grateful during the holidays and New Year’s? Share your best sober holiday stories!

summary.en: December is a great time of year to reach out to alcoholics and help others. What are the ways you stay sane and grateful during the holidays and New Year’s? Share your best sober holiday stories!
summary.es: Diciembre es una gran época del año para llegar a los alcohólicos y ayudar a otros. ¿Cuáles son las formas de permanecer sano y agradecido durante las fiestas y Año Nuevo? ¡Comparte tus mejores historias de fiestas sobrias!

items.title: Remote Communities
items.summary: Do you live far from AA meetings? Are you a loner? Stationed far away? Do you have a language or cultural barrier? Are you homebound? Do you use online meetings? Are you involved in Remote Community service? Tell us how you stay sober.

summary.en: Do you live far from AA meetings? Are you a loner? Stationed far away? Do you have a language or cultural barrier? Are you homebound? Do you use online meetings? Are you involved in Remote Community service? Tell us how you stay sober.
summary.es: ¿Vive lejos de las reuniones de AA? ¿Eres un solitario? ¿Estado lejos? ¿Tiene un idioma o una barrera cultural? ¿Estás en casa? ¿Usas reuniones en línea? ¿Está involucrado en el servicio de la comunidad remota? Cuéntanos cómo te mantienes sobrio.

items.title: AA in the Military
items.summary: Did you ever serve in the military sober? Were you ever stationed overseas or on a ship while trying to stay sober? What were AA meetings like in the military? What were some of the challenges? Did you find AA while serving? Tell us about being in AA while serving your country.

summary.en: Did you ever serve in the military sober? Were you ever stationed overseas or on a ship while trying to stay sober? What were AA meetings like in the military? What were some of the challenges? Did you find AA while serving? Tell us about being in AA while serving your country.
summary.es: ¿Has servido alguna vez en el sobrio militar? ¿Alguna vez estuvo estacionado en el extranjero o en un barco mientras trataba de mantenerse sobrio? ¿Cómo eran las reuniones de AA en el ejército? ¿Cuáles fueron algunos de los desafíos? ¿Encontraste AA mientras servías? Háblenos de estar en AA mientras sirve a su país.

items.title: Young & Sober
items.summary: Did you come into AA at an early age? What was that like? What were the challenges? Do you go to Young People’s AA (YPAA) meetings, dances or conferences? How have they helped you?

summary.en: Did you come into AA at an early age? What was that like? What were the challenges? Do you go to Young People’s AA (YPAA) meetings, dances or conferences? How have they helped you?
summary.es: ¿Has entrado en AA a una edad temprana? ¿Cómo fue eso? ¿Cuáles fueron los desafíos? ¿Vas a las reuniones, bailes o conferencias de Young People’s AA (YPAA)? ¿Cómo te han ayudado?

items.title: Sober Seniors
items.summary: What are some challenges you have getting older in AA? Are you in assisted living? How do you get to AA meetings? How do you stay connected to the Fellowship? Did you get sober later in life? Do you do service reaching out to senior members? Share your experiences

summary.en: What are some challenges you have getting older in AA? Are you in assisted living? How do you get to AA meetings? How do you stay connected to the Fellowship? Did you get sober later in life? Do you do service reaching out to senior members? Share your experiences
summary.es: ¿Cuáles son algunos desafíos que tienes envejeciendo en AA? ¿Estás en la vida asistida? ¿Cómo llegas a las reuniones de AA? ¿Cómo te mantienes conectado a la Comunidad? ¿Te has sobrio más tarde en la vida? ¿Haces servicio al llegar a los miembros mayores? Comparte tus experiencias

items.title: Annual Prison Issue
items.summary: Did you find AA in prison? What is sobriety like inside? What are meeting like? Are you involved in correspondence service or prison sponsorship? We are especially looking for stories by women in long-term custody.

summary.en: Did you find AA in prison? What is sobriety like inside? What are meeting like? Are you involved in correspondence service or prison sponsorship? We are especially looking for stories by women in long-term custody.
summary.es: ¿Encontraste a AA en prisión? ¿Cómo es sobriedad dentro? ¿Cómo se reúnen? ¿Está involucrado en el servicio de correspondencia o la prisión padrinazgo? Estamos especialmente buscando historias de mujeres bajo custodia a largo plazo.

items.title: Emotional Sobriety
items.summary: Over time, how have you learned to use the tools of AA to gain serenity and peace? How has your life changed? Share some examples of emotional sobriety in your life today.

summary.en: Over time, how have you learned to use the tools of AA to gain serenity and peace? How has your life changed? Share some examples of emotional sobriety in your life today.
summary.es: Con el tiempo, ¿cómo has aprendido a usar las herramientas de AA para ganar serenidad y paz? ¿Cómo ha cambiado tu vida? Comparte algunos ejemplos de Sobriedad emocional en tu vida hoy.

items.title: Fun in Sobriety
items.summary: We’re not a glum lot. Been on any fun sober trips? How about camping, skiing, skydiving, dancing, collecting, acting, reading, cooking, volunteering? What about service events, new hobbies, game nights, sober vacations? Share your sober adventures! Let’s hear from you!

summary.en: We’re not a glum lot. Been on any fun sober trips? How about camping, skiing, skydiving, dancing, collecting, acting, reading, cooking, volunteering? What about service events, new hobbies, game nights, sober vacations? Share your sober adventures! Let’s hear from you!
summary.es: No somos un grupo sombrío. ¿Has estado en algún divertido viaje sobrio? ¿Qué tal acampar, esquiar, paracaidismo, bailar, coleccionar, actuar, leer, cocinar, voluntariado? ¿Qué hay de eventos de servicio, nuevos pasatiempos, noches de juego, vacaciones sobrias? ¡Comparte tus aventuras sobrias! ¡Oigamos de usted!

items.title: What’s on Your Mind?
items.summary: Have thoughtful ideas about meetings, sponsorship, sobriety, Traditions or anything AA? Tell us how you really feel. “What’s On Your mind?” is one of our most popular columns. This is your chance to share exactly what’s on your mind. We want to know.

summary.en: Have thoughtful ideas about meetings, sponsorship, sobriety, Traditions or anything AA? Tell us how you really feel. “What’s On Your mind?” is one of our most popular columns. This is your chance to share exactly what’s on your mind. We want to know.
summary.es: ¿Tiene ideas reflexivas sobre reuniones, padrinazgo, sobriedad, Tradiciones o algo AA? Cuéntanos cómo te sientes. “¿Qué hay en tu mente?” es una de nuestras columnas más populares. Esta es tu oportunidad de compartir exactamente lo que hay en tu mente. Queremos saberlo.

items.title: Longtime Members!
items.summary: Let’s hear from our longtimers! What was AA like when you came in? What have you learned over the years? What have been your greatest challenges and joys? Share your stories.

summary.en: Let’s hear from our longtimers! What was AA like when you came in? What have you learned over the years? What have been your greatest challenges and joys? Share your stories.
summary.es: ¡Oigamos de nuestro veteranos! ¿Cómo era AA cuando entraste? ¿Qué has aprendido con los años? ¿Cuáles han sido tus mayores desafíos y alegrías? Comparte tus historias.

items.summary: Share your personal journey with Step Two. How did you find your Higher Power? Did you struggle with Step Two? What helped you? Tell us your experience.

items.title: Dealing with Loneliness
items.summary: Members don’t often share about loneliness. How do you deal with it in sobriety? What was your experience with loneliness when you were still drinking? What’s it like now? What are the tools you use to combat loneliness and to reach out for help and fellowship.

summary.en: Members don’t often share about loneliness. How do you deal with it in sobriety? What was your experience with loneliness when you were still drinking? What’s it like now? What are the tools you use to combat loneliness and to reach out for help and fellowship.
summary.es: Los miembros no suelen compartir sobre la soledad. ¿Cómo lidiar con eso en sobriedad? ¿Cuál fue tu experiencia con la soledad cuando aún estabas bebiendo? ¿Cómo es ahora? ¿Cuáles son las herramientas que utiliza para combatir la soledad y para llegar a la ayuda y compañerismo?

items.summary: Share your experiences of sponsoring others or of being sponsored. What are some of the things you learned? What things do you now pass on? Share your story.
